questions.question: In The Usual Suspects, what is the name of the mythical crime lord Verbal Kint describes?
questions.note: Kevin Spacey’s Verbal tells the story; the twist is who Keyser really is.

questions.question: In Fargo, what is the name of Frances McDormand’s pregnant police chief?
questions.note: 1996 Coen brothers; McDormand won Best Actress. Solverson is the later TV series.

questions.question: In No Country for Old Men, what is the name of Javier Bardem’s hitman?
questions.note: He settles arguments with a coin toss. Moss is Josh Brolin’s hunter; Bell is Tommy Lee Jones’s sheriff.

questions.question: In Reservoir Dogs, what color alias does Tim Roth’s undercover cop use?
questions.note: 1992 — Tarantino’s debut. Steve Buscemi is Mr. Pink; Harvey Keitel is Mr. White.

questions.question: Which Las Vegas casino houses the vault in Ocean’s Eleven (2001)?
questions.note: They also hit The Mirage and the MGM Grand in the same sting.

questions.question: The Departed (2006) is set in which U.S. city?
questions.note: A remake of the Hong Kong film Infernal Affairs; Scorsese’s Best Picture winner.

questions.question: In Heat (1995), who plays the LAPD detective hunting Robert De Niro’s crew?
questions.note: Pacino is Vincent Hanna; De Niro is Neil McCauley. Their diner scene is the famous face-off.

questions.question: In Se7en, what is the last name of Morgan Freeman’s weary detective?
questions.note: Brad Pitt is David Mills. The killer is John Doe.

questions.question: In The Big Lebowski, what is The Dude’s actual name?
questions.note: The other Jeffrey Lebowski is the millionaire whose rug gets peed on.

questions.question: In Fight Club, what is the name of Helena Bonham Carter’s character?
questions.note: Edward Norton’s narrator; Brad Pitt is Tyler Durden.
